metadata.question: Does the urban area of Medina, Saudi Arabia expand between June, 1984 and July, 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Medina, Saudi Arabia (Point 39.611, 24.467), buffer 30 km.
- Dates:
  - Early: 1984-06-01 to 1984-07-31 (fallback to LT04 or LE07; if empty, widen to full 1984).
  - Late: 2018-06-15 to 2018-08-15 (fallback to LE07 or Sentinel-2; if empty, widen to full 2018).
- Collections: Landsat C2 L2 (LT05 primary for 1984, LC08 primary for 2018). 

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Yes, mask clouds/shadows using QA_PIXEL bits for Landsat; QA60 for Sentinel-2 if used.
- Compute "available pixel" count using data mask only (no clouds) and "valid pixel" count after cloud mask to estimate cloud%.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after fallbacks: C1.
- If available pixels > 0 but valid cloud-free pixels == 0: C2.
- If area computations return null/NaN/invalid: C3.
- Otherwise compare built-up area (NDBI>0 and NDVI<0.3) between 1984 and 2018 to decide A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const city = ee.Geometry.Point([39.611, 24.467]); // Medina
  const region = city.buffer(30000).bounds(); // ~30 km buffer
  const scale = 1000; // per instruction, >= 1000 m for regional stats

  const earlyPrefStart = '1984-06-01';
  const earlyPrefEnd   = '1984-07-31';
  const earlyWideStart = '1984-01-01';
  const earlyWideEnd   = '1984-12-31';

  const latePrefStart = '2018-06-15';
  const latePrefEnd   = '2018-08-15';
  const lateWideStart = '2018-01-01';
  const lateWideEnd   = '2018-12-31';

  // 2. Sensor prep and cloud masking
  function applyScaleRenameL57(img) {
    const scaled = img.select([
      'SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5'
    ], ['RED','NIR','SWIR']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
  }
  function applyScaleRenameL8(img) {
    const scaled = img.select([
      'SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6'
    ], ['RED','NIR','SWIR']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
  }
  function maskDataOnlyLandsat(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const dataMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0); // bit 0 Fill == 0
    return img.updateMask(dataMask);
  }
  function maskCloudsLandsat(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0) // Fill = 0
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)) // Dilated cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // Cirrus
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // Cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // Cloud shadow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // Snow
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }
  // Sentinel-2 fallback (if needed)
  function applyScaleRenameS2(img) {
    // S2 SR scale factor 1e-4; keep simple scaling
    const scaled = img.select(['B4','B8','B11'], ['RED','NIR','SWIR']).multiply(1e-4);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
  }
  function maskDataOnlyS2(img) {
    // Use presence of bands as proxy for data; keep original mask
    return img.updateMask(img.select('NIR').mask());
  }
  function maskCloudsS2(img) {
    // Simple mask using QA60 bits 10 and 11 (clouds, cirrus)
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0));
    return img.updateMask(cloud.not());
  }

  async function getCompositeForWindow(start, end, sensors) {
    for (let s of sensors) {
      try {
        let col = ee.ImageCollection(s.id).filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end);
        const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (size === 0) continue;

        let colData, colCloud;
        if (s.type === 'LT5' || s.type === 'LT4' || s.type === 'LE7') {
          colData  = col.map(applyScaleRenameL57).map(maskDataOnlyLandsat);
          colCloud = col.map(applyScaleRenameL57).map(maskCloudsLandsat);
        } else if (s.type === 'LC8' || s.type === 'LC9') {
          colData  = col.map(applyScaleRenameL8).map(maskDataOnlyLandsat);
          colCloud = col.map(applyScaleRenameL8).map(maskCloudsLandsat);
        } else if (s.type === 'S2') {
          colData  = col.map(applyScaleRenameS2).map(maskDataOnlyS2);
          colCloud = col.map(applyScaleRenameS2).map(maskCloudsS2);
        } else {
          continue;
        }
        const rawComp = colData.median().clip(region);
        const cloudComp = colCloud.median().clip(region);
        // Validate that composites have some data
        const avail = await getInfoAsync(rawComp.select('NIR').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }));
        const availCount = (avail && avail.NIR) ? avail.NIR : 0;
        if (availCount === 0) continue;

        return { rawComp, cloudComp, size, sensor: s.type, id: s.id };
      } catch (e) {
        // Try next sensor
        continue;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function getBuiltStats(start, end, primarySensors, fallbackStart, fallbackEnd) {
    let comp = await getCompositeForWindow(start, end, primarySensors);
    if (!comp) {
      comp = await getCompositeForWindow(fallbackStart, fallbackEnd, primarySensors);
    }
    if (!comp) return { status: 'C1' };

    // Pixel counts
    const availDict = await getInfoAsync(comp.rawComp.select('NIR').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const validDict = await getInfoAsync(comp.cloudComp.select('NIR').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const availableCount = (availDict && availDict.NIR) ? availDict.NIR : 0;
    const validCount = (validDict && validDict.NIR) ? validDict.NIR : 0;
    if (availableCount === 0) return { status: 'C2' };
    if (validCount === 0) return { status: 'C2', availableCount, validCount };

    // Indices and built-up mask
    const img = comp.cloudComp;
    const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['NIR', 'RED']).rename('NDVI');
    const ndbi = img.normalizedDifference(['SWIR', 'NIR']).rename('NDBI');
    const built = ndbi.gt(0).and(ndvi.lt(0.3));

    // Area calculation
    const builtAreaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(built).rename('area');
    const areaDict = await getInfoAsync(builtAreaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const areaM2 = areaDict ? areaDict.area : null;
    if (areaM2 === null || areaM2 === undefined) return { status: 'C3' };
    const areaKm2 = areaM2 / 1e6;

    const cloudPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (1 - validCount / availableCount) * 100));

    return {
      status: 'OK',
      areaKm2,
      availableCount,
      validCount,
      cloudPct,
      images: comp.size,
      sensor: comp.sensor
    };
  }

  try {
    const regionAreaDict = await getInfoAsync(ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const regionAreaKm2 = regionAreaDict ? (regionAreaDict.constant || regionAreaDict.pixelarea || regionAreaDict.area || regionAreaDict.sum) : null;
    const regionArea = regionAreaKm2 ? (regionAreaKm2 / 1e6) : null;

    const sensors1984 = [
      {id: 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', type: 'LT5'},
      {id: 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2', type: 'LT4'},
      {id: 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', type: 'LE7'}
    ];
    const sensors2018 = [
      {id: 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2', type: 'LC8'},
      {id: 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', type: 'LE7'},
      {id: 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED', type: 'S2'}
    ];

    const early = await getBuiltStats(earlyPrefStart, earlyPrefEnd, sensors1984, earlyWideStart, earlyWideEnd);
    const late  = await getBuiltStats(latePrefStart,  latePrefEnd,  sensors2018, lateWideStart,  lateWideEnd);

    if (early.status === 'C1' || late.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (early.status === 'C2' || late.status === 'C2') {
      // Print some context before final tag
      if (regionArea) console.log(`Region km2: ${regionArea.toFixed(1)}`);
      if (early.status === 'OK') {
        console.log(`1984 ${early.sensor} Images: ${early.images}, AvailPx: ${early.availableCount}, ValidPx: ${early.validCount}, Cloud%: ${early.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
      } else {
        console.log(`1984 No Valid Pixels`);
      }
      if (late.status === 'OK') {
        console.log(`2018 ${late.sensor} Images: ${late.images}, AvailPx: ${late.availableCount}, ValidPx: ${late.validCount}, Cloud%: ${late.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
      } else {
        console.log(`2018 No Valid Pixels`);
      }
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (early.status === 'C3' || late.status === 'C3') {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Valid results
    if (regionArea) console.log(`Region km2: ${regionArea.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`1984 ${early.sensor} Images: ${early.images}, AvailPx: ${early.availableCount}, ValidPx: ${early.validCount}, Cloud%: ${early.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`1984 Built-up km2: ${early.areaKm2.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`2018 ${late.sensor} Images: ${late.images}, AvailPx: ${late.availableCount}, ValidPx: ${late.validCount}, Cloud%: ${late.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`2018 Built-up km2: ${late.areaKm2.toFixed(2)}`);

    const delta = late.areaKm2 - early.areaKm2;
    const pct = early.areaKm2 > 0 ? (delta / early.areaKm2) * 100 : null;
    if (pct === null || !isFinite(pct)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Change km2: ${delta.toFixed(2)}; Percent: ${pct.toFixed(1)}%`);

    // Decision: expansion if increase > 10%
    if (delta > 0 && pct > 10) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
